answers.core: It deals with how nodes relate and communicate with each-other, and depending on which of the above options was picked would require integration with all of Godot's scripting/programming systems, or with inter-node communication in the UI.
answers.workaround: There is currently no way to do anything like this without tying the parent nodes to the child-component nodes through exports, as well as requiring the export chain to be set up manually through scripts every time, and updated if one of the child-components is changed.

title: Allow for exposing properties on parent nodes from child nodes (multiple alternative suggestions how it could be implemented)
